title: paper place setting placemats
text: paper place setting placemats. purchased these to use at our annual seafood boil as sort of a joke... as there are never any plates or utensils used... I placed them on top of the newspaper. They are fairly thin paper... but they are disposable so I think that is good.  They are on the longer side... not short.
